reference: No GNU command implements this process-local shell queue; expected values are derived from the published docs/sol-fifo.md API contract, the help text contract, and an independent abstract list plus peek-cursor model. These are contract tests, not GNU CLI parity claims.
coverage: Bash builtin availability and the documented help interface
Decimal signed-int input, FIFO order, depth, and non-consuming peek
Successful push, unget, pull, and clear cursor resets
Atomic rejection of malformed batches and request status 2 behavior
INT_MIN/INT_MAX, decimal leading zeros, and invalid integer forms
Capacity 64, all-values ordering across ring wrap, and overflow rejection
Queue and cursor retention after closed-stdout write errors
exclusions: There is no equivalent GNU/POSIX external command, so no cases are labeled parity.
A true ENOSPC or partial-write failure at fflush is deferred because it needs a controlled failing-writer mock; absolute device paths are outside this fixture scope.
Terminal input decoding and integration with an interactive application are outside this in-memory queue API.

cases.purpose: Confirm Bash advertises fifo as a builtin, as documented by the loadable API.
Check that Bash help exposes the documented FIFO operations, numeric rules, cursor behavior, status codes, write-failure contract, and shell-state scope; formatting is left to Bash's help builtin.
cases.script:
help_text=$(help fifo)
required=(
  'Process-local 64-entry input FIFO of signed int events.'
  'fifo push INT [INT...]'
  'fifo pull'
  'fifo peek'
  'fifo unget INT [INT...]'
  'fifo clear'
  'fifo depth'
  'push and unget preserve argument order and reject a whole invalid batch.'
  'Successful push, unget, pull and clear reset the peek cursor to the head.'
  'depth and failed operations preserve the cursor; exhausted peek returns 1.'
  'Status: 0 success; 1 empty/exhausted or output error; 2 invalid request.'
  'Failed output preserves the queue and cursor (partial output is possible).'
  'State persists in this shell; subshells inherit a private copy.'
)
for fragment in "${required[@]}"; do
  [[ $help_text == *"$fragment"* ]] || exit 92
done
printf 'documented-help-contract=present\n'

cases.purpose: Move the empty ring head to offset 60, fill all 64 slots across wraparound, reject an over-capacity batch atomically, and independently check every dequeued value in order.
cases.script:
nums=()
for ((i=0; i<60; i++)); do nums+=("$i"); done
fifo push "${nums[@]}"
for ((i=0; i<60; i++)); do
  fifo pull > .fifo-event
  IFS= read -r got < .fifo-event
  [[ $got == "$i" ]] || exit 70
done
nums=()
for ((i=0; i<64; i++)); do nums+=("$((100+i))"); done
fifo push "${nums[@]}"
if fifo push 200 201; then rc=0; else rc=$?; fi
printf 'over-capacity=%d\n' "$rc"
fifo depth
for ((i=0; i<64; i++)); do
  fifo pull > .fifo-event
  IFS= read -r got < .fifo-event
  want=$((100+i))
  [[ $got == "$want" ]] || exit 71
done
printf 'ordered-full-ring=64\n'
fifo depth
if fifo pull; then rc=0; else rc=$?; fi
printf 'empty-after-drain=%d\n' "$rc"
